<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant M peak with successive M+1, M+2, M+3… peaks decreasing roughly in proportion to the natural ¹³C abundance and combinatorial probabilities—the pattern matches that of carbon isotopes in a molecule containing many carbon atoms. No distinct patterns characteristic of chlorine, bromine, sulfur, etc., are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
